newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Europe and CIS port conditions - Lloyds.
newsitem.headline: Europe and CIS port conditions - Lloyds.

text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

BULGARIA Sept 30 - Varna - East 4 vessels loading at berth, 3 discharging at berth, 1 waiting at anchorage to load, 4 awaiting orders. West 7 vessels loading at berth, 1 discharging at berth. Bourgas - east 17 vessels due, 8 loading at berth, 4 discharging at berth, 7 waiting at anchorage to load, 2 to discharge, 7 under repairs/drydock. Conditions 23/9 to 30/9 Varna - 30 vessels operating of which 17 loading, 2 urea, 7 soda, 1 cement, 1 trucks/containers, 1 tsp, 1 ntp, 1 general/kaoline, 1 scrap, 1 quartz sand, 1 container. 6 discharging, 2 containers, 1 sugar, 1 phosphorite, 2 coal, 7 discharging/loading - 4 containers, 1 timber/containers, 2 trucks/containers. 9 waiting in roads of which 3 to load 1 soda, 1 containers, 1 scrap, 6 cargo not nominated.

CROATIA, Sept 30 - Rasa - one vessel loading at berth. Rijeka - one discharging at berth, 4 loading, 5 under repairs/drydock, 5 due, delays expected. Zadar - one discharging at berth, 3 due, delays expected. Ploce - one loading at berth. Pula, Sibenik, Split, Dubrovnik - no vessels in ports.

ESTONIA, 30 Sept - Tallinn city port 2 vessels due, no delays expected, 3 loading (wire rods, steel billets, sawn timber). Kopli 4 due, no delays, 1 sawn timber loading. Muuga 2 due, no delays, 4 loading at berth of which 3 oil, 1 fertiliser, 1 waiting to load, 2 ferries. Parnu 4 due, no delays, 3 loading (1 timber, 2 paper) 2 discharging (fish, material support.

ITALY, Oct 1 - Naples - One gas tanker berthed 1 container vessel etb 2/10. 2 bulk carriers, first berthing 1/10, second 2/10. Gaeta - One bulk carrier, etb 2/10 or 3/10, 1 freezer, etb 2/10. Salerno - No vessels in roads. Genoa commercial port - One vessel in roads no delays, 31 vessels berthed, 6 in drydock. Multedo oil harbour - No vessels in roads, no delays, 3 berthed. Savona - No vessels in roads, no delays, 1 vessel berthed. Vado Ligure - No vessels in roads, no delays, no vessels berthed.

La Spezia - No vessels in roads, no delays, 8 berthed, 5 under repairs. Leghorn - Four vessels in roads, 33 berthed. Civitavecchia - One vessel in roads. Gaeta, Naples, Salerno - No vessels in roads, no delays. Augusta oil harbour - One in roads, 5 berthed. Syracuse oil harbour - Two in roads, 2 berthed. Palermo - No vessels in roads, no delays. Sarroch - Three in roads, 3 berthed. Taranto - Ten in roads totalling 449,897 dwt. Ravenna - No information. Ancona/Falconara - No vessels/no delays. Venice - No information. Trieste - Two in roads.

POLAND, Oct 1 - Szczecin - 78 vessels due. Delays expected. 40 loading at berth, 38 discharging. 1 discharging at anchorage. 2 waiting at anchorage to discharge. 7 under repairs/drydock. Gdynia - Nine vessels operating. 2 wheat vessels awaiting turn. 6 loading at berth of which 2 containers, 2 general cargo, 2 coal. 3 discharging at berth of which 2 containers, 1 corn. 7 under repairs/drydock. 38 Vessels due. Gadnsk - nine operating. 4 awaiting turn of which 3 coal, 1 wheat. 6 loading at berth of which 1 coal, 2 bulk, 3 general cargo. 3 discharging at berth of which 2 corn, 1 tanker. 3 under repairs/drydock. 17 vessels due.

PORTUGAL, Sept 27 - Sines - Vessels operating 1 loading propylene, 1 loading gasoline, gas oil and jet fuel, 1 discharging coal. Due - 1 to load gasoline, gasoil and jet fuel, 1 to discharge chemical naphtha, 1 to discharge/load fuel, 1 to load propylene, 3 to discharge coal.
Oct 1 - Setubal - vessels in port 3 loading at berth. 4 discharging at berth. 7 under repairs/drydock. Due: 7 for discharging, 6 for loading. 2 vessels for repairs/drydock.

ROMANIA, Oct 1 - Constanta 41 vessels operating, 21 generals (17 loading, 4 discharging). 11 bulkers (7 loading, 4 discharging). 5 chemicals loading. 1 tanker discharging. 2 bagged cement loading. 1 container discharging. 4 waiting in roads of which 1 general discharger, 1 bulker loader, 1 bagged chemicals loader, 1 bagged cement loader. Constanta South Agigea - two general cargo loading. Mangalia - one bagged chemicals loading. Midia - one livestock carrier loading.

RUSSIA, Sept 30 - Baltic ports, St. Petersburg - 15 vessels operating of which loading 5 non-ferrous, 2 fertiliser, 1 each containers, cellulose, coal. Discharging 3 containers, 2 frozen chicken. 5 waiting. 16 due. Kaliningrad - Nine vessels in port of which 8 operating, 1 coal loader, 2 scrap metal loaders, 1 wheat loader, 1 cellulose loader, 1 banana discharger, 1 feed discharger, 1 meat discharger. 1 awaiting operations. No delays. 1 due. Vyborg - Two operating. No delays. 5 due.

Far East, Vladivostok - 12 in port of which 2 passenger, 5 loading (3 metal, 1 timber, 1 container vessel), 5 waiting. Nakhodka - 11 in port, 1 passenger, 6 loading (1 general, 3 metal, 2 timber), 4 waiting. Vostochniy - four in port of which 3 loading (2 coal, 1 metal), 1 waiting. Posiet - one loading metal. Khasan - no vessels. No delays or congestion in ports.

Black Sea, Novorossiysk - 11 vessels operating of which 9 loading, 1 cement, 5 steel, 1 scrap, 1 pipes, 1 urea. 2 discharging, 1 rice, 1 container. 10 waiting in roads of which 5 to load 1 steel, 1 sheep, 1 molasses, 1 copper cathodes, 1 scrap. 5 to discharge, 2 rice, 1 alumina, 1 container vessel, 1 helicopter. 18 due of which 13 to load, 1 cast iron, 9 steel, 1 copper, 1 general, 1 autos. 5 to discharge, 1 sugar, 1 zinc concentrate, 2 luggage, 1 cars. Oil terminal 2 loading crude. 5 waiting in roads of which 3 to load crude, 1 fuel oil, 1 gasoil. 8 due of which 7 to load crude, 1 load fuel oil.

Northern Basin, Oct 1 - Murmansk - five vessels operating of which 1 alumina, 1 steel, 1 NPK, 1 apatite, 1 cabotage. 1 apatite loader waiting. 7 due during week, 4 loaders (2 apatite, 1 npk, 1 non-ferrous), 2 dischargers (alumina, cabotage).

SLOVENIA, Sept 30 - Koper - Nine vessels due in next 2 days of which 4 containers loading/discharging, 1 bulker to discharge chrome ore, 1 ferry to load trucks, 1 general cargo to load steels/paper, 1 reefer to discharge fruit, 1 livestock to load cattle. 9 berthed of which 3 containers loading/discharging, 2 bulkers loading of which 1 wheat, 1 coal, 1 general cargo loading steel products/pulp, 1 reefer discharging bananas, 2 livestock vessels loading cattle. No delays expected.

SPAIN, Sept 30 - Aviles - Three in port of which 1 loading steel products, 2 discharging scrap/iron ore. Gijon - Six in port, 1 loading cement, 1 under repairs, 4 discharging petcoke, steel products, butane gas, gasoil. No delays. Sagunto - 16 operating, 3 ro/ro discharging/loading, 1 loading cement, 2 surgical products, 1 discharging liquid ammonia, 7 surgical products, 1 citrus. No vessels berthed outside commercial wharf. No delays. Oct 1 Pasajes - 18 in port of which 6 discharging scrap, 1 granite, 2 fertiliser, 1 woodpulp, 2 steel, 1 petcoke. 2 discharging/loading cars. 2 loading steel. 1 under repairs. Cadiz - 18 operating, 4 ro/ro, 3 sugar, 1 sand, 2 wheat, 2 semolina, 2 shipbuilding, 1 cement. 3 under repairs. No delays.

UKRAINE, Oct 1 - Odessa - Steel cargo loading, 1 vessel alongside. 1 anchored. 5 due. Containers, 1 alongside. 6 anchored. Grain cargo discharging, 1 alongside. Grain loading, 1 vessel due. Sugar discharging, 1 alongside. 1 Due. Tanker loading, 5 alongside. General cargo, 2 alongside. 3 due. Fertiliser, 1 alongside. Ilyichevsk - Steel cargo loading, 6 alongside. 3 anchored. General cargo, 3 alongside. 1 anchored. Fertiliser, 1 alongside. Mariupol - Seven loading at berth (fertiliser, coal, metal). 3 discharging (alumina, lighters, general cargo. 5 waiting to load (fertiliser, coal, sulphur, urea). 1 metal products waiting to discharge. 9 floating storehouses (fertiliser, sulphur). 23 due (metal products, coal, fertiliser, general cargo, alumina). Kerch - Two vessels under repairs/drydock. Berdiansk - two loading metal products. Mariupol - nine operating of which 6 loading, 2 map, 2 coal, 1 steel, 1 coke. 2 discharging 1 miscellaneous, 1 equipment. 1 Discharging/loading containers. 6 in roads of which 5 to load, 3 coal, 1 map, 1 sulphur. 1 to discharge steel coils. 25 due of which 19 to load, 4 coal, 9 steel, 4 fertiliser, 1 container, 1 ferrous metal. 4 to discharge, 1 containers, 1 alumina, 1 metal, 1 unspecified. 2 to discharge/load containers. Odessa - 12 in port of which 4 loading, 1 urea, 2 metal, 1 sugar. 2 discharging 1 seedcake, 1 sugar. 1 discharging/loading containers. 4 passenger. 1 waiting. 7 in roads of which 5 to load/2 oil, 1 paper, 1 steel, 1 fuel. 1 awaiting documents. 1 other waiting. 17 due of which 8 to load/5 metal, 1 sunflower, 1 gasoil, 1 paper. 4 to discharge, 1 sugar, 2 bananas, 1 citrus. 5 To discharge/load containers.
